page.layout: Running head across the top, page number at top right; one column of text; small marks in the right margin beside the lines "A-" and "tit."; signature at bottom left and catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: vero moratus sit tantum, inquit, hæsitatur, an, si postea in mora non fuerit, extingua tur superior mora. Et Celsus adolescens scribit, eü qui moram fecit in soluedo Sticho quem promiserat, posse eme dare eam moram postea offerendo. esse enim hanc quæstionem de bono & æquo, in quo genere plerumque sub auctoritate iuris sciëtiæ, per niciose (inquit) erratur. Aliud exemplum. Lex est: depositum ei qui depositum reddatur. Latro spolia mea depositu apud Mæuium. Vterque nostrum ea simul repetit. Intentio mea: Hæc res mi[illegible, ~3 letters]

page.notes: Right-margin marks beside "A-" and "tit." are printed symbols I could not identify; they are not transcribed. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Doubtful readings: "niciose", "sciëtiæ", "depositu", "eü". The page ends mid-word ("mi") at the foot of the column; catchword "hi" is read from the foot right. Several letters in the first lines are faint.
